name: Source authority mapping formation
observation: Schema delivery, workspace-link routing, and repository ownership required the same source-to-receiver authority distinctions across three material corpora.
decisionEffect: The resting source-authority-mapping candidate formed one portable skill contract with the source-ownership and promotion-route work as its first natural use.
smallestAction: Create one instruction-first skill, one typed exchange example, and one material ownership map.
transferBoundary: The account records local instruction yield and leaves publication rights and source authority with their existing stewards.
reentryTrigger: Another cross-system promotion creates an authority ambiguity or a receiver cannot reconstruct lineage.
